question: Imperfect’ is the autobiography of which Indian cricketer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sanjay Manjrekar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Sanjay Manjrekar** is a former Indian cricketer who played for India from 1987 to 1996 as a batsman.
 
• He is well-known for his technical proficiency and solid defense as a batsman.
 
• Post-retirement, Sanjay Manjrekar has worked as a cricket commentator and analyst, earning respect for his insights and knowledge of the game.
 
• His autobiography, titled '**Imperfect**', provides an introspective look into his cricketing career, personal life, and the challenges he faced both on and off the field.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Autobiography**

 
 
• An autobiography is a self-written account of the life of a person. It offers a personal perspective on the individual's experiences, thoughts, and feelings.
 
• It differs from a biography, which is the life story of a person written by someone else.
 
• Autobiographies often provide insight into the author’s personality and their interpretation of events.
 
• They are valuable for understanding the personal history and motivations behind significant figures.
 
 
 
• **Indian Cricket**
 
 
• Cricket is one of the most popular sports in India, and the Indian cricket team is one of the most successful teams in international cricket.
 
• India has won several major ICC trophies, including the ICC Cricket World Cup, ICC T20 World Cup, and ICC Champions Trophy.
 
• Many Indian cricketers, past and present, are considered legends of the game, such as Sachin Tendulkar, Kapil Dev, and Virat Kohli.
 
• The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) is the governing body for cricket in India.
 
 
 
• **Cricket Commentary**
 
 
• Cricket commentary involves providing a live description and analysis of the game. It can be delivered on radio, television, or through digital platforms.
 
• Commentators often include former players who bring their experience and understanding of the game to their commentary.
 
• Good commentary enhances the viewing experience by offering deeper insights into strategies, player performances, and game dynamics.
 
• Famous cricket commentators include Richie Benaud, Harsha Bhogle, and Michael Holding.
